WITH L0 AS (
    SELECT OBJECTID, geometry
    FROM Discoveries WHERE (field_hc_type = 'CONDENSATE') and (included_in_discovery_name ILIKE '%Hansteen%')
),
L1 AS (
    SELECT OBJECTID, geometry
    FROM Pipelines WHERE PipelinesType = cast(0 as SMALLINT)
),
J0 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT A.OBJECTID
    FROM L0 A
    JOIN L1 B
    ON ST_Intersects(A.geometry, B.geometry)
)
SELECT
    L.OBJECTID
FROM Discoveries L
JOIN J0 M0 ON L.OBJECTID = M0.OBJECTID

    SELECT DISTINCT A.OBJECTID

    JOIN L1 B
    ON ST_DWithin(A.geometry, B.geometry, 10000.0)

)

FROM Wells L
